<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Add opt-in PrimTS DSA and sliding-window attention for Step5 on Blackwell (SM100/103/107), supporting BF16 and pure E4M3 QKV. Requires [FlashInfer #7106](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/7106); builds on #61727.

## Claims

- Native remains the default. When enabled, PrimTS handles supported prefill; BF16 decode uses PrimTS at captured/padded batch size ≥32 with MTP=3. FP8 decode always uses PrimTS.
- Reuses existing cache producers, selectors and gate. FP8 Q quantization is fused into the Q/KV producer, with output retained in the model activation dtype.
- SWA uses the runtime-length FlashInfer `max_q_len` API. Logical Q/KV capacities remain planning/workspace bounds, while compiled attention is reused across changing lengths.
- Fixed-Q decode derives metadata from KV lengths; packed prefill shares asynchronously uploaded grouping offsets across layers. Scheduler and CUDA-graph padding behavior are unchanged. Upstream native SM100 admission is preserved.

## Validation

Rebased onto vLLM main `5ea83019`; measured at vLLM `8612c29ed3` / FlashInfer `c7f1a3ca`. Four GB300 GPUs, TP=4/MTP=3, CuTe DSL 4.8.0, PyTorch 2.14 NVIDIA build / CUDA 13.4. Other stack versions and raw outputs are retained with the validation artifacts.

**Compilation.** Empty independent software compilation caches for each backend, followed by a fresh-process restart reusing that arm’s caches. After server readiness, prompt lengths 128, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192 and 16384 each run twice.

| Backend | Cold readiness s¹ | Restart readiness s¹ | Prims-TS builds during cold probes | Builds during restart probes |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Native BF16 | 706.4 | 328.2 | 0 | 0 |
| PrimTS BF16 | 804.4 | 336.2 | 0 | 0 |
| PrimTS FP8 | 844.5 | 330.2 | 0 | 0 |

¹ Readiness includes model loading, JIT compilation and graph warmup; filesystem weight-cache state is uncontrolled. Build records may repeat across TP ranks. The previous 20–40 s Prims-TS bucket stalls no longer reproduce in the tested prompt matrix. A shared score-scheduler compile of about 0.9 s remains at first 8K and also occurs in native; this is separate from Prims-TS attention specialization. The full accuracy runs also add zero Prims-TS specializations in either PrimTS arm; each backend adds nine shared score-scheduler variants.

**Accuracy.** Full GPQA Diamond, AIME 2024 and GSM8K, two repeats per backend: **9,282 responses**. Natural prompts, temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, high reasoning, max_tokens=1,000,000, max_model_len=1,048,576. Identical frozen prompts/seeds across backends. A common native BF16 local model extracts every saved response without reference answers; supporting quotations and extraction disagreements are audited. Predictions are frozen before comparison; two GSM8K reference items stated in shoe pairs are converted to individual-shoe units before exact numeric comparison. Scores use this common audited extraction, so they are not a direct reproduction of the earlier parser.

| Dataset | Questions/repeat | Native | PrimTS BF16 | PrimTS FP8 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| GPQA Diamond | 198 | 92.93% | 93.43% | 90.66% |
| AIME 2024 | 30 | 100.00% | 98.33% | 98.33% |
| GSM8K | 1319 | 97.04% | 96.97% | 96.82% |

FP8 GPQA is **2.27 percentage points below native** in this two-repeat campaign; these results do not establish accuracy equivalence. All requested responses are included, with zero generation request errors.

<details><summary>Accuracy counts by repeat</summary>

| Dataset | Native repeat 0 / repeat 1 | PrimTS BF16 repeat 0 / repeat 1 | PrimTS FP8 repeat 0 / repeat 1 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| GPQA Diamond | 178 of 198 / 190 of 198 | 187 of 198 / 183 of 198 | 178 of 198 / 181 of 198 |
| AIME 2024 | 30 of 30 / 30 of 30 | 30 of 30 / 29 of 30 | 30 of 30 / 29 of 30 |
| GSM8K | 1281 of 1319 / 1279 of 1319 | 1278 of 1319 / 1280 of 1319 | 1277 of 1319 / 1277 of 1319 |

</details>

Native BF16: 6 responses without a unique exact answer (counted incorrect); 0 length-truncated responses.

PrimTS BF16: 2 responses without a unique exact answer (counted incorrect); 0 length-truncated responses.

PrimTS FP8: 3 responses without a unique exact answer (counted incorrect); 0 length-truncated responses.

**End-to-end serving.** Official `vllm bench serve`, real weights and frozen LongBench Qasper-derived prompts, prefix caching disabled, prefill chunk 8192. One warmup trial excluded, then three measured trials; table reports medians. Input labels are approximate; tokenizer-reported counts are retained.

| Backend | 8K/B1 TTFT ms | 160K/B1 TTFT s | 96K input/concurrency32 TTFT s | TPOT ms/token | Output tokens/s |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Native BF16 | 281.10 | 6.239 | 58.945 | 116.715 | 128.59 |
| PrimTS BF16 | 246.63 | 5.516 | 51.539 | 104.706 | 145.17 |
| PrimTS FP8 | 246.05 | 5.503 | 51.238 | 103.104 | 145.44 |

<details><summary>Measured trial ranges (minimum–maximum; three trials)</summary>

| Backend | 8K TTFT ms | 160K TTFT s | Concurrency32 TPOT ms/token |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Native BF16 | 281.061–281.144 | 6.236–6.241 | 115.720–116.776 |
| PrimTS BF16 | 246.427–246.677 | 5.510–5.519 | 103.525–107.422 |
| PrimTS FP8 | 245.770–248.106 | 5.502–5.519 | 102.084–103.469 |

</details>

The concurrency32 case generates 512 tokens per request and includes scheduling, ongoing prefill and MTP acceptance effects. It is a serving workload, not an isolated fixed-batch decode-forward measurement.

**Local correctness.** 16 adapter tests and 18 fused-producer tests pass, including BF16/FP8 long-KV cases (8K/160K), partial packed requests, inactive requests and CUDA-graph replay against independent references. Numerical references/tolerances are unchanged. The numerical fixture restores TF32 state explicitly for compatibility with PyTorch’s cuBLAS proxy.

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/models/step5/test_prims_ts_attention.py
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/kernels/test_fused_qknorm_rope_cache.py
```

The changed CUDA target is rebuilt with CUDA 13.4/SM103 over published native libraries whose compiled sources match the pinned main commit. Pre-commit passes for the rebased range and follow-up.

## Details

Enable with `--kernel-config '{"step5_attention_backend":"prims_ts"}'` and `--kv-cache-dtype bfloat16` or `fp8_e4m3`. Block size 32; MTP=3 means three draft tokens plus one target token (Q=4). Query dtype follows backend/cache configuration independently of batch routing.

Hardware validation covers GB300/SM103. SM100/107 remain untested locally, and H200 CI cannot execute the PrimTS adapter cases. No duplicate Step5 PrimTS integration exists in pinned main; existing integrations for other models are distinct. AI assistance was used for implementation and validation.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""Step5 routing, cache scales, and request-safe PrimTS adapter bindings."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.step5.nvidia.prims_ts import (
+    Step5PrimsTSSparse,
+    uses_prims_ts_attention,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.flash_attn import FlashAttentionMetadata
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def full_precision_matmul():
+    previous = torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32
+    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = previous
+
+
+def _metadata(capacity, live, query_len, device="cpu"):
+    offsets = torch.arange(capacity + 1, device=device, dtype=torch.int32)
+    offsets *= query_len
+    offsets[live + 1 :] = live * query_len
+    lengths = torch.full((capacity,), 64, device=device, dtype=torch.int32)
+    lengths[live:] = 0
+    slots = torch.arange(capacity * query_len, device=device, dtype=torch.int64)
+    slots[live * query_len :] = -1
+    metadata = FlashAttentionMetadata(
+        num_actual_tokens=capacity * query_len,
+        max_query_len=query_len,
+        query_start_loc=offsets,
+        max_seq_len=64,
+        seq_lens=lengths,
+        block_table=torch.zeros((capacity, 2), device=device, dtype=torch.int32),
+        slot_mapping=slots,
+    )
+    metadata.num_actual_reqs = capacity
+    return metadata
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "capacity,live,query_len,spec_tokens,kv_cache_dtype,expected",
+    [
+        (1, 1, 64, 3, "auto", True),
+        (31, 31, 4, 3, "auto", False),
+        (32, 31, 4, 3, "auto", True),
+        (32, 32, 4, 3, "auto", True),
+        (64, 64, 1, 3, "auto", False),
+        (32, 32, 2, 3, "auto", False),
+        (1, 1, 1, 0, "fp8", True),
+        (1, 1, 4, 3, "fp8_e4m3", True),
+    ],
+)
+def test_prims_ts_routes_by_cache_dtype_and_padded_batch_size(
+    capacity, live, query_len, spec_tokens, kv_cache_dtype, expected
+):
+    assert (
+        uses_prims_ts_attention(
+            _metadata(capacity, live, query_len), spec_tokens, kv_cache_dtype
+        )
+        == expected
+    )
+
+
+def _require_cuda():
+    if not current_platform.is_cuda() or not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        pytest.skip("Step5 attention kernels require CUDA")
+    if torch.cuda.get_device_capability() not in ((10, 0), (10, 3), (10, 7)):
+        pytest.skip("Step5 PrimTS adapters require SM100, SM103 or SM107")
+
+
+def _reference(query, cache, table, owners, positions, *, ids):
+    """FP32 reference over exact input values and independently selected blocks."""
+    output = torch.zeros_like(query, dtype=torch.float32)
+    groups, page_size = cache.shape[1:3]
+    heads = query.shape[1] // groups
+    offsets = torch.arange(8, device=query.device)
+    for row, (owner, position) in enumerate(
+        zip(owners.cpu().tolist(), positions.cpu().tolist())
+    ):
+        if position < 0:
+            continue
+        for group in range(groups):
+            blocks = torch.cat((ids[row, group], ids.new_full((1,), position // 8)))
+            tokens = (blocks[:, None] * 8 + offsets).flatten()
+            tokens = tokens[(tokens >= 0) & (tokens <= position)]
+            pages = table[owner, tokens // page_size].long()
+            content = cache[pages, group, tokens % page_size].float()
+            q = query[row, group * heads : (group + 1) * heads].float()
+            probabilities = torch.softmax(
+                q @ content[:, :192].T * (1.25 / 192**0.5), -1
+            )
+            output[row, group * heads : (group + 1) * heads] = (
+                probabilities @ content[:, 192:] * 0.75
+            )
+    return output.to(torch.bfloat16)
+
+
+def _inputs(dtype, context, query_lengths, kv_lengths):
+    page_size, groups, heads, dim = 32, 2, 16, 192
+    pages_per_request = (context + page_size - 1) // page_size
+    pages = len(query_lengths) * pages_per_request
+    query = torch.randn((sum(query_lengths), heads, dim), device="cuda").to(dtype)
+    cache = torch.randn((pages, groups, page_size, 2 * dim), device="cuda").to(dtype)
+    table = torch.randperm(pages, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32).view(
+        len(query_lengths), pages_per_request
+    )
+    owner_values: list[int] = []
+    position_values: list[int] = []
+    starts = [0]
+    for request, (qlen, kvlen) in enumerate(zip(query_lengths, kv_lengths)):
+        owner_values.extend([request] * qlen)
+        position_values.extend(range(kvlen - qlen, kvlen) if kvlen > 0 else [-1] * qlen)
+        starts.append(starts[-1] + qlen)
+    owners = torch.tensor(owner_values, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    positions = torch.tensor(position_values, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int64)
+    return query, cache, table, owners, positions, starts
+
+
+def _selected_reference(scores, positions, topk):
+    current = positions // 8
+    regions = torch.arange(scores.shape[-1], device=scores.device)
+    masked = scores.masked_fill(
+        regions[None, None] >= current[:, None, None], -torch.inf
+    )
+    ids = masked.topk(min(topk, scores.shape[-1]), dim=-1).indices
+    return torch.where(ids < current[:, None, None], ids, -1)
+
+
+def _assert_accuracy(output, expected, dtype):
+    assert torch.isfinite(output).all()
+    error = torch.linalg.vector_norm(output.float() - expected.float())
+    error /= torch.linalg.vector_norm(expected.float()).clamp_min(1e-6)
+    assert error < (0.04 if dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn else 0.01)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "dtype,context,topk",
+    [
+        (torch.float8_e4m3fn, 64, 8),  # Distinct all-history/no-score path.
+        (torch.bfloat16, 8192, 512),
+        (torch.float8_e4m3fn, 8192, 512),
+        (torch.bfloat16, 163840, 512),
+        (torch.float8_e4m3fn, 163840, 512),
+    ],
+)
+@pytest.mark.usefixtures("full_precision_matmul")
+def test_prims_ts_packed_prefill_matches_reference(dtype, context, topk):
+    _require_cuda()
+    torch.manual_seed(11)
+    # Long KV also exercises grouped prefill with partial request tails.
+    if context == 64:
+        query_lengths = (3, 5)
+    elif context == 163840:
+        query_lengths = (1025, 1029)
+    else:
+        query_lengths = (257, 263)
+    query, cache, table, owners, positions, starts = _inputs(
+        dtype, context, query_lengths, (context, context - 13)
+    )
+    regions = (context + 7) // 8
+    adapter = Step5PrimsTSSparse(query.device, context, topk)
+    plan = adapter.prepare_prefill_attention(
+        (query.shape[0], 8, 192),
+        dtype,
+        query.device,
+        cache.shape[2],
+        positions,
+        min(regions, topk) + 1,
+        192**-0.5,
+        request_offsets=starts,
+        num_kv_groups=2,
+    )
+    metadata = adapter.prefill_metadata(
+        owners, positions, regions, topk, out=plan.ids, history_only=True
+    )
+    output = torch.empty_like(query, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    plan.bind(
+        query,
+        cache,
+        table,
+        output,
+        owners=owners,
+        positions=positions,
+        qk_scale=1.25,
+        v_scale=0.75,
+    )
+    scores = torch.randn((query.shape[0], 2, regions), device="cuda")
+    expected_ids = _selected_reference(scores, positions, topk)
+    for group in range(2):
+        start = 0
+        for chunk in metadata:
+            end = start + chunk.current.numel()
+            if regions > topk:
+                adapter.select_regions(
+                    scores[start:end, group].contiguous(),
+                    chunk.current,
+                    topk,
+                    topk_lengths=chunk.topk_lengths,
+                    sort=False,
+                    out=plan.selection_output(start, end),
+                    history_only=True,
+                )
+            start = end
+        plan.finish(query[:, group * 8 : (group + 1) * 8], cache, output)
+    expected = _reference(query, cache, table, owners, positions, ids=expected_ids)
+    _assert_accuracy(output, expected, dtype)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "dtype,batch,query_len",
+    [
+        (torch.float8_e4m3fn, 4, 1),
+        (torch.bfloat16, 32, 4),
+        (torch.float8_e4m3fn, 32, 4),
+    ],
+)
+@pytest.mark.usefixtures("full_precision_matmul")
+def test_prims_ts_long_decode_and_mtp_replay(dtype, batch, query_len):
+    _require_cuda()
+    torch.manual_seed(29)
+    context, topk, groups = 163840, 512, 2
+    kv_lengths = [context - request * 13 for request in range(batch)]
+    kv_lengths[-1] = 0
+    query, cache, table, owners, positions, _ = _inputs(
+        dtype, context, [query_len] * batch, kv_lengths
+    )
+    tokens, heads, dim = query.shape
+    scores = torch.randn(tokens, groups, context // 8, device="cuda")
+    seq_lens = torch.tensor(kv_lengths, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    active = (positions >= 0).repeat_interleave(groups)
+    decode_positions = positions.clamp_min(0).repeat_interleave(groups)
+    current = decode_positions // 8
+    topk_lengths = current.int()
+    output = torch.zeros_like(query, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    adapter = Step5PrimsTSSparse(query.device, context, topk)
+
+    def run():
+        adapter.select_and_run_decode_attention(
+            query.view(tokens * groups, heads // groups, dim),
+            cache,
+            scores.view(tokens * groups, -1),
+            current,
+            topk,
+            table,
+            decode_positions,
+            active,
+            output.view(tokens * groups, heads // groups, dim),
+            192**-0.5,
+            seq_lens=seq_lens,
+            topk_lengths=topk_lengths,
+            query_len=query_len,
+            k_scale=1.25,
+            v_scale=0.75,
+        )
+
+    def check():
+        ids = _selected_reference(scores, positions, topk)
+        expected = _reference(query, cache, table, owners, positions, ids=ids)
+        _assert_accuracy(output, expected, dtype)
+        assert torch.count_nonzero(output[positions < 0]) == 0
+
+    run()
+    check()
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        run()
+    # Replay the same capacity with a different inactive request and KV tails.
+    kv_lengths[-1], kv_lengths[0] = context - 21, 0
+    seq_lens.copy_(torch.tensor(kv_lengths, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32))
+    local_q = torch.arange(query_len, device="cuda")
+    updated = (seq_lens[:, None] - query_len + local_q).flatten()
+    positions.copy_(torch.where(seq_lens.repeat_interleave(query_len) > 0, updated, -1))
+    active.copy_((positions >= 0).repeat_interleave(groups))
+    decode_positions.copy_(positions.clamp_min(0).repeat_interleave(groups))
+    current.copy_(decode_positions // 8)
+    topk_lengths.copy_(current)
+    output.zero_()
+    graph.replay()
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    check()

+"""BF16/FP8 PrimTS attention plans for Step5's cache and selector ABI."""
+
+import math
+
+import torch
+
+from .flashinfer_sparse import Step5FlashInferSparse
+from .ops.attention_gate import headwise_sigmoid_gate
+
+MIN_DECODE_BATCH_SIZE = 32
+_SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE = 8
+
+
+def uses_prims_ts_attention(metadata, num_speculative_tokens, kv_cache_dtype):
+    if metadata is None or metadata.num_actual_tokens == 0:
+        return False
+    if kv_cache_dtype in ("fp8", "fp8_e4m3"):
+        return True
+    # Full CUDA graphs select attention using their padded request capacity.
+    requests, query_len = metadata.num_actual_reqs, metadata.max_query_len
+    decode = (
+        metadata.num_actual_tokens == requests * query_len
+        and query_len <= num_speculative_tokens + 1
+    )
+    if not decode:
+        return True
+    return (
+        num_speculative_tokens == 3
+        and query_len == 4
+        and requests >= MIN_DECODE_BATCH_SIZE
+    )
+
+
+def get_kv_cache_and_scales(query, cache, layer):
+    """View the cache and return descales for Q quantized by the producer.
+
+    QK uses q_scale * k_scale and PV uses v_scale inside attention. Cache
+    views and cached CPU scales require no GPU kernel or data transfer.
+    """
+    if cache.dtype == torch.uint8:
+        cache = cache.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    if query.dtype != cache.dtype or cache.dtype not in (
+        torch.bfloat16,
+        torch.float8_e4m3fn,
+    ):
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            "Step5 PrimTS requires matching BF16/E4M3 QKV; "
+            "FP8 Q must be quantized by the Q/KV producer"
+        )
+    if cache.dtype == torch.bfloat16:
+        return cache, 1.0, 1.0
+    return cache, layer._q_scale_float * layer._k_scale_float, layer._v_scale_float
+
+
+def _require_qkv(query, cache):
+    """Check Step5's shared K/V channels; FlashInfer receives zero-copy slices."""
+    if query.dtype != cache.dtype or query.dtype not in (
+        torch.bfloat16,
+        torch.float8_e4m3fn,
+    ):
+        raise NotImplementedError("Step5 PrimTS requires homogeneous BF16 or E4M3 QKV")
+    if cache.shape[-1] != 2 * query.shape[-1]:
+        raise ValueError("Step5 cache must concatenate K/V with 2 * head_dim channels")
+
+
+def _sparse_wrapper(query, cache, table, offsets, group, topk, model_len, split_kv):
+    from flashinfer.attention.prims_ts import (
+        QTokenKvBlockSparsePagedTSWrapper,
+        get_q_token_kv_block_sparse_workspace_size,
+    )
+
+    _require_qkv(query, cache)
+    head_dim = query.shape[-1]
+    model_len = min(model_len, table.shape[1] * cache.shape[2])
+    size = get_q_token_kv_block_sparse_workspace_size(
+        query,
+        cache[..., :head_dim],
+        table,
+        block_topk=topk,
+        max_seq_len_kv=model_len,
+        qo_indptr=offsets,
+        group_size=group,
+        kv_block_size=_SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE,
+        split_kv=split_kv,
+        share_pattern_across_kv_heads=False,
+        count_current_block_in_topk=False,
+        o_data_type=torch.bfloat16,
+    )
+    workspace = torch.empty(size, dtype=torch.uint8, device=query.device)
+    wrapper = QTokenKvBlockSparsePagedTSWrapper()
+    wrapper.plan(
+        offsets.numel() - 1 if offsets is not None else query.shape[0] * query.shape[1],
+        query.shape[-2],
+        cache.shape[1],
+        head_dim,
+        _SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE,
+        cache.shape[2],
+        topk,
+        model_len,
+        group_size=group,
+        device=query.device,
+        workspace_buffer=workspace,
+        use_packed_q=offsets is not None,
+        split_kv=split_kv,
+        share_pattern_across_kv_heads=False,
+        count_current_block_in_topk=False,
+        q_data_type=query.dtype,
+        o_data_type=torch.bfloat16,
+    )
+    return wrapper
+

+class Step5PrimsTSDecode:
+    """Reuse a fixed-Q plan over vLLM's existing request capacity."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        query,
+        cache,
+        table,
+        *,
+        topk,
+        query_len,
+        model_len,
+        num_sms,
+    ):
+        from flashinfer.attention.prims_ts import (
+            suggest_q_token_kv_block_sparse_group_size,
+        )
+
+        if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            raise RuntimeError("Warm Step5 PrimTS decode before graph capture")
+        self.head_dim = query.shape[-1]
+        self.groups = cache.shape[1]
+        tokens = query.shape[0] // self.groups
+        self.tokens = tokens
+        if tokens % query_len:
+            raise ValueError("Fixed decode must contain complete requests")
+        self.heads = query.shape[1] * self.groups
+        self.query_len = query_len
+        self.topk = topk
+        # Current contributes up to one full block outside the history budget.
+        max_selected_kv_tokens = (topk + 1) * _SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE
+        self.group = suggest_q_token_kv_block_sparse_group_size(
+            batch_size=self.tokens // query_len,
+            seq_len_q=query_len,
+            selected_seq_len_kv=max_selected_kv_tokens,
+            num_qo_heads=self.heads,
+            num_kv_heads=self.groups,
+            multi_processor_count=num_sms,
+            head_dim=self.head_dim,
+            q_data_type=query.dtype,
+            split_kv=True,
+            kv_block_size=_SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE,
+        )
+        self.group = math.gcd(self.group, query_len)
+        self.shape = (
+            tokens // query_len,
+            query_len // self.group,
+            self.group,
+            self.heads,
+            self.head_dim,
+        )
+        self.ids = torch.empty(
+            (self.tokens, self.groups, topk), dtype=torch.int32, device=query.device
+        )
+        self.wrapper = _sparse_wrapper(
+            query.view(self.shape),
+            cache,
+            table,
+            None,
+            self.group,
+            topk,
+            model_len,
+            True,
+        )
+
+    def run(
+        self,
+        query,
+        cache,
+        table,
+        seq_lens,
+        active,
+        out,
+        scale,
+        gate,
+        v_scale=1.0,
+    ):
+        tokens = query.shape[0] // self.groups
+        if tokens != self.tokens:
+            raise ValueError("Decode shape must match its vLLM request capacity")
+        self.wrapper.run(
+            query.view(self.shape),
+            (cache[..., : self.head_dim], cache[..., self.head_dim :]),
+            table,
+            self.ids,
+            seq_lens=seq_lens,
+            sm_scale=scale,
+            v_scale=v_scale,
+            out=out.view(self.shape),
+        )
+        output = out.view(tokens, self.heads, self.head_dim)
+        if gate is not None:
+            # TODO: fuse the gate into the final epilogue, preserving BF16 rounding.
+            headwise_sigmoid_gate(
+                output.flatten(1),
+                gate,
+                active=active.view(tokens, self.groups)[:, 0],
+                out=output.flatten(1),
+            )
+

+class Step5PrimsTSPrefill:
+    """Collect all provider selections, then run one multi-head sparse launch."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        shape,
+        dtype,
+        device,
+        positions,
+        region_count,
+        scale,
+        request_offsets,
+        groups,
+        model_len,
+        num_sms,
+        *,
+        max_topk=None,
+    ):
+        from flashinfer.attention.prims_ts import (
+            make_q_token_kv_block_sparse_qo_indptr,
+            suggest_q_token_kv_block_sparse_group_size,
+        )
+
+        tokens, heads, dim = shape
+        if dtype not in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float8_e4m3fn):
+            raise NotImplementedError("Step5 PrimTS prefill requires BF16/E4M3 queries")
+        self.head_dim = dim
+        lengths = [
+            int(b - a) for a, b in zip(request_offsets[:-1], request_offsets[1:])
+        ]
+        self.groups, self.tokens = groups, tokens
+        self.topk = region_count - 1 if max_topk is None else max_topk
+        self.scale, self.model_len = scale, model_len
+        # This is a per-query capacity, not the original context length.
+        max_selected_kv_tokens = (self.topk + 1) * _SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE
+        self.group = suggest_q_token_kv_block_sparse_group_size(
+            batch_size=len(lengths),
+            seq_len_q=max(lengths),
+            selected_seq_len_kv=max_selected_kv_tokens,
+            num_qo_heads=heads * groups,
+            num_kv_heads=groups,
+            multi_processor_count=num_sms,
+            head_dim=dim,
+            q_data_type=dtype,
+            split_kv=False,
+            kv_block_size=_SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE,
+        )
+        cpu_offsets = make_q_token_kv_block_sparse_qo_indptr(
+            torch.as_tensor(request_offsets, dtype=torch.int32, device="cpu"),
+            tokens,
+            group_size=self.group,
+            device="cpu",
+        )
+        self.offsets = cpu_offsets.pin_memory().to(device, non_blocking=True)
+        self.ids = torch.empty(
+            tokens, groups, self.topk, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+        )
+        self.query_buffer = None
+        self.wrapper = None
+
+    def page_metadata(self, table, owners, page_stride=1, start=0, end=None):
+        # PrimTS builds its own union; leave the selector's ordinary IDs intact.
+        return None
+
+    def fixup_positions(self, positions):
+        self.positions = positions
+
+    def bind(
+        self,
+        query,
+        cache,
+        table,
+        output,
+        *,
+        owners,
+        positions,
+        qk_scale=1.0,
+        v_scale=1.0,
+    ):
+        _require_qkv(query, cache)
+        self.owners, self.positions = owners, positions
+        self.qk_scale, self.v_scale = qk_scale, v_scale
+        self.query_buffer = query
+        self.cache, self.table, self.output = cache, table, output
+        self.current_group = 0
+        if self.wrapper is None:
+            self.wrapper = _sparse_wrapper(
+                query,
+                cache,
+                table,
+                self.offsets,
+                self.group,
+                self.topk,
+                self.model_len,
+                False,
+            )
+
+    def selection_output(self, start, end):
+        return self.ids[start:end, self.current_group]
+
+    def finish(self, query, cache, out):
+        if self.wrapper is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("Bind PrimTS prefill buffers before finishing")
+        self.current_group += 1
+        if self.current_group == self.groups:
+            self.wrapper.run(
+                self.query_buffer,
+                (self.cache[..., : self.head_dim], self.cache[..., self.head_dim :]),
+                self.table,
+                self.ids,
+                self.owners,
+                self.positions,
+                qo_indptr=self.offsets,
+                sm_scale=self.scale * self.qk_scale,
+                v_scale=self.v_scale,
+                out=self.output,
+            )
+

+class Step5PrimsTSSWA:

+
+    def __init__(self, model_len, window):
+        self.model_len, self.window = model_len, window
+        self.plans = {}
+
+    def run(self, query, cache, metadata, output, gate, scale, v_scale=1.0):
+        from flashinfer.attention.prims_ts import (
+            BatchDecodePagedTSWrapper,

+        table = metadata.block_table[:requests]

+            q_capacity,

+                )

+                wrapper.plan(
+                    device=query.device,
+                    batch_size=requests,
+                    max_q_len=q_capacity,
+                    max_kv_len=model_len,
+                    num_qo_heads=query.shape[1],
+                    num_kv_heads=cache.shape[1],
+                    head_dim=head_dim,

+                cache[..., :head_dim],
+                cache[..., head_dim:],

+                output[:n].flatten(1),
+                gate[:n],
+                slot_mapping=metadata.slot_mapping[:n],

+            num_kv_heads=self.groups,
+            multi_processor_count=num_sms,
+            head_dim=192,
+            q_data_type=query.dtype,
+            split_kv=True,
+            kv_block_size=8,
+        )
+        self.group = math.gcd(self.group, query_len)

+            tokens // query_len,
+            query_len // self.group,
+            self.group,
+            self.heads,
+            192,
+        )
+        self.ids = torch.empty(
+            (self.tokens, self.groups, topk), dtype=torch.int32, device=query.device
+        )

+            batch_size=len(lengths),

+            selected_seq_len_kv=self.topk * 8 + 8,
+            num_qo_heads=heads * groups,
+            num_kv_heads=groups,

+            split_kv=False,
